arguments.text: 8000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: watch pod power vs heart rate and vs GPS speed for pod drift; correct pod_gain if it drifts. (2) Spot drag (weed) via push_local dropping within a leg while heading constant; clear_rudder if so. (3) Handle radio messages (course changes: set_race_distance + tell). (4) Check the CP/reserve via heart-rate trend at steady effort mid-race. Avoid wasting cues; finish rule only spends reserve if pod reserve > 40% at 800 m to go.

arguments.text: Course now 9250 m (radio at 945 s; computer set at 1024 s; paddler told at 1190 s). Pacer owns effort. CP ~ test value (177 W pod); pod reserve ~5% after my test piece, so hold ~177 W to the finish. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest (pod drift: compare pod vs HR and vs GPS with measure(share=0.67) in both directions; a drop in both directions = drag or pod change, opposite signs = current). (2) Weed: clear_rudder if push drops in both directions at steady pod. (3) Radio messages. (4) Near the finish: pacer finish rule needs pod reserve >40% at 800 m (will not fire); if the reserve has refilled, use a short final piece in the last ~600-800 m to spend it. Hull fit 1240-1325 s: share 0.674, push ~0.

t=1325s: measure at fixed share 0.662: back 420-760 +0.027, out 950-1040 +0.035, out 1100-1180 -0.009, back 1240-1325 +0.016 => no current shift, no pod drift; push_local +0.107 at 1320 s was a lag artifact (pod dropped faster than boat speed). Pod fell to ~166 W after the piece (paddler forced down or own pacing); HR 173.8 not falling.

Same direction (back legs) as the pre-drift baseline 420-760 s (pod 178, boat 122).
